name: robots/jjshoots__crazyflyt
title: Crazyflie 2.x (CrazyFlyt DroneController)
intro: Crazyflie 2.x (CrazyFlyt DroneController), adapted from jjshoots/crazyflyt. It reads `position_estimate`, `setpoint` and `running`; sets `pos_control`; runs `set_position_setpoint`, `set_velocity_setpoint` and `halt`. `set_position_setpoint`: store an (x, y, z, yaw) setpoint in m and rad, select position control and start the control thread. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
